name: garbo-scenes-vs-code-extension
description: Fetch slide definitions from Storykit CWS and write them into garbo-scenes directories as JSON.

definitionExtension.callbackPort.description: Fixed loopback port for the OAuth callback. Must match an Allowed Callback URL registered in Auth0: http://127.0.0.1:<port>/callback. Shared by both environments.

definitionExtension.stage.auth0Domain.description: Stage: Auth0 tenant domain (no protocol), e.g. your-tenant.us.auth0.com.

definitionExtension.stage.auth0ClientId.description: Stage: Auth0 application Client ID (Native/SPA app, PKCE-enabled).

definitionExtension.stage.auth0Audience.description: Stage: Auth0 API identifier (audience). Required to get a JWT access token instead of an opaque one.

definitionExtension.stage.auth0Scope.description: Stage: OAuth scopes to request. Include offline_access to receive a refresh token.

definitionExtension.stage.redirectUri.description: Stage: OAuth redirect_uri sent to /authorize and /oauth/token. Must be registered as an Allowed Callback URL in Auth0.

definitionExtension.stage.apiBaseUrl.description: Stage: Base URL for authenticated API requests.

definitionExtension.production.auth0Doma.description: Production: Auth0 tenant domain (no protocol), e.g. your-tenant.us.auth0.com.

definitionExtension.production.auth0Clie.description: Production: Auth0 application Client ID (Native/SPA app, PKCE-enabled).

definitionExtension.production.auth0Audi.description: Production: Auth0 API identifier (audience). Required to get a JWT access token instead of an opaque one.

definitionExtension.production.auth0Scop.description: Production: OAuth scopes to request. Include offline_access to receive a refresh token.

definitionExtension.production.redirectU.description: Production: OAuth redirect_uri sent to /authorize and /oauth/token. Must be registered as an Allowed Callback URL in Auth0.

definitionExtension.production.apiBaseUr.description: Production: Base URL for authenticated API requests.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run typecheck && npm run compile
